Australian organisations should be aware of two key issues this week. The Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has warned about critical vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway — if your organisation uses these products, IT teams should apply patches immediately. Separately, businesses are being reminded that privacy law reforms are approaching, and waiting until legislation passes before acting could leave organisations scrambling to comply.

On the scam front, large enterprises are being targeted by convincing fake merger and acquisition emails designed to trick staff into revealing sensitive information or transferring funds. If you receive unexpected communication about a business deal or acquisition, verify it through official channels before responding or acting.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email about a merger, acquisition, or urgent financial matter, call the sender directly using a known phone number — never one provided in the email itself.
